name: Decor Bridge
description: Local bridge that lets an AI assistant read and decorate the level open in the editor, live.

enabled.name: Enable bridge
enabled.description: Runs a small HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 only. Restart the game after changing this.

port.name: Port
port.description: Restart the game after changing this.

area-key.name: Area key
area-key.description: Hold in the editor and drag with the mouse to mark an area for the assistant (GET /area). A click without dragging clears it.
